verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal app, and a built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a terminal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or task delegation. The docs cover SSH, Mosh, key management, themes, keyboard shortcuts and VS Code connectivity, which do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
